title: Environment Act 2008
citation: Act No. 10 of 2008; Supplement No. 1 to Gazette No. 80 of 5th December, 2008, p. 299-366
evidence: No commencement date is stated on the official page or in the Gazette text. Supplement No. 1 to Gazette No. 80 of 5th December, 2008, p. 299; Section 1(2) states: "This Act shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may, by notice published in the Gazette appoint and the Minister may appoint different dates for the coming into operation of different Parts of this Act." Opened https://environment.gov.ls/download/environment-act-2008/ on 2026-11-05.
notes: Link only (Varun, 2026-11-05): the Copyright Order 1989 s. 5(a) covers rules or decisions of courts and administrative bodies, not Acts of Parliament, so LS-DOE-ADOPTED is unknown and no text is stored. Framework environmental statute enacted by the Parliament of Lesotho (Act No. 10 of 2008), repealing the Environment Act 2001. Published in Supplement No. 1 to Gazette No. 80 on 5 December 2008. Section 1(2) provides that the Act comes into operation on a date appointed by the Minister by notice in the Gazette. English (en) is an official language and the sole language of enactment and gazette publication; no official Sesotho translation is published.
